pageDesc: High-frequency utilities picked out of existing projects: 90+ pure functions and 25 Hooks, all zero-dependency and stripped of business logic. The pure functions are covered by npm test (zero-dependency node assertions, no vitest required).
freqDebounceDesc: Updates only 400ms after you stop typing; suits search suggestions and form validation.
freqThrottleDesc: Updates at most once per 600ms; suits scrolling / rapid clicking.
freqFnDesc: Wrap callbacks directly; both expose cancel() and clean up automatically on unmount.
freqRetryDesc: Automatically retries N times on failure; sleep is the Promise flavour of setTimeout.
fmtRelativeDesc: just now / x minutes ago / x hours ago / x days ago, falling back to a date after 30 days.
fmtDiffDesc: Whole days between two dates; returns 0 for invalid input.
fmtFileDesc: Three commonly used formatters: file size, thousands separator and percentage.
fmtMaskDesc: Keeps the head and tail while masking the middle; commonly used when displaying phone / ID numbers.
arrGroupDesc: Group by field, deduplicate and sort; each returns a new array and leaves the original untouched.
arrIndexDesc: Turns an array into an object keyed by key for O(1) lookups.
arrFlattenDesc: Expands nested arrays to a given depth; Infinity flattens everything.
arrMergeDesc: Recursive merging and field picking; neither mutates its arguments.
treeFlatDesc: Flattens a tree into a one-dimensional array for easier searching / counting.
treeBuildDesc: Rebuilds the hierarchy from id / parentId; commonly used for flat API responses.
treeFindDesc: Depth-first lookup for a node by id; returns null when it isn't found.
storeLSDesc: Two-way sync with localStorage, with expiry support; it survives a page reload.
storeOnlineDesc: Listens for online / offline events; typical offline notices rely on it.
storeMediaDesc: Reactive breakpoint matching, so you don't hardcode breakpoints inside JS.
interactWmDesc: Tiled rendering on canvas plus a MutationObserver guard — deleting it brings the watermark back automatically.
interactWmText: This area is watermarked (try deleting the watermark node in the console to verify self-healing)
interactOutsideDesc: Typical for dropdowns / popovers; the caller creates the ref and passes it in.
interactPanel: Panel content: click outside to close
interactHoverDesc: Hover state and element size (driven by ResizeObserver).
interactSize: Drag the window width and watch the size:
interactCopyDesc: Prefers the Clipboard API and degrades gracefully on failure; the copied state resets on its own.
stateToggleDesc: Less boilerplate than hand-writing useState + negation, with setOn / setOff thrown in.
stateCounterDesc: Clamped between a min and a max; good for quantity pickers / pagination stepping.
stateIntervalDesc: Pass null as delay to pause; cleans up automatically on unmount.
exportCsvDesc: Writes a BOM so Excel shows Chinese correctly; values escape quotes and newlines automatically.
exportCopyJson: Copy the first row as JSON
textEnhanceDesc: Truncation, counting mixed Chinese / Latin text, full-width to half-width, regex escaping, URL slugs, avatar initials — edit the input and see the result instantly.
textCheckDesc: Email, mainland China mobile number, national ID (with check digit), URL, numbers and Chinese-only text. Edit the input to validate instantly.
textColorDesc: The same string always yields the same color, so auto-coloring users / tags needs no lookup table; contrastColor returns black or white based on luminance to avoid white text on a light background.
calcStatDesc: Sum, average, median, share, range checks, decimal places and milliseconds to a Chinese duration string. The median skips non-numbers automatically.
calcSetTitle: Set operations (all return new arrays and never mutate the original)
calcSetDesc: Chunking, sequences, shuffling, sampling, difference / intersection / union, dropping falsy values, moving elements, counting and summing by field.
calcMove: Move the first item to the end
calcPathDesc: Supports the 'a.b[0].c' syntax. get returns a fallback instead of throwing; set writes immutably and returns a new object.
calcDateDesc: Start / end of day, adding and subtracting days, same-day checks, Chinese weekday names, days in a month and leap-year checks.
newNowDesc: Returns a fresh Date on every interval, powering clocks or auto-refreshing text like "just now / 3 minutes ago". Pass null to stop refreshing.
newCountdownDesc: Counted from a target timestamp rather than decrementing every tick — setInterval drifts once the tab gets throttled, and only timestamp arithmetic avoids running slower and slower.
newSetDesc: Saves a pile of spread syntax in bulk-select and tag scenarios. Every operation returns a new Set, so React notices the reference change.
newUpdateTitle: useUpdate · force re-render / useEventListener · declarative listeners
newUpdateDesc: useUpdate forces a refresh when you depend on mutable data outside React; useEventListener unbinds automatically on unmount. The line below shows the key you press on this page.
